title: Representation-independent extension: the pulled-back integral is the limit of Y(ω_j) for a sequence of test forms chosen before Y and R
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝ^P open, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on O (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O), K ⊆ O compact, and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n). Then there is a sequence (ω_j)_{j∈ℕ} in 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) such that for every Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) and every integer multiplicity triple R = (M, θ, ξ) in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) representing Y with spt Y ⊆ K: Y(ω_j) → ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(f(x))∘Df(x)) dHⁿ(x) as j → ∞, where Hⁿ = μHE[n], Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x and ω(f(x))∘Df(x) := (ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → ∃ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ∀ (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), R.Represents Y → Y.support ⊆ K → Tendsto (fun j => Y (ωs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]))
